summary: Creating a workflow job template under Automation Execution > Templates > Create workflow job template with Name, Organization, Inventory and Limit; a workflow limit is only passed to job templates that have Prompt on launch for Limit.
questions: Why isn't my workflow limit applied to the job templates?
How do I create a workflow job template?
Does a workflow inventory override the job template inventory?

answer_card.title: Workflow limit not passed down
answer_card.answer_md: A **Limit** set on a workflow job template only reaches a job template node if that job template has **Prompt on launch** checked for *Limit*. Otherwise the job template runs with its own limit, which can make playbooks fail if they need one.
